card: This pull request documents the rounding behavior of CFeeRate fee getters in header comments and removes mentions of an edge-case for negative fee rates. It solves minor documentation ambiguity for developers calling fee calculation methods after their inline definitions were moved to a source file. The change has no stated external dependencies and carries low risk.
evidence: PR description: 'Now that the impl moved into the C++ file in 38ece2a9c853ae3db9afb5215611c3e23e40461f, it could make sense to document the rounding behavior in the header file doxygen comment.'

PR description: 'drop the "special case", which seems more confusing than helpful. (It is only a special case for negative feerates, which are mostly irrelevant and only possible with manual fee prioritization deltas)'
problem: After fee calculation implementations were moved into a source file, the rounding behavior was no longer visible in header files, leaving callers without explicit documentation on rounding semantics.

risk.why: Inaccurate documentation on fee rounding could mislead developers writing fee-calculation code, but the changes appear limited to comments.

scope_notes: The patch is small (+8/-18 across 4 files) and primarily consists of documentation updates, though the diff was not included in the prompt.
summary: Clarifies header Doxygen comments regarding the rounding behavior of CFeeRate fee calculation methods. It also removes documentation of a confusing special case that applied only to negative fee rates.
uncertainties: The diff was not provided, so exact code changes or potential minor behavioral tweaks cannot be verified.
